about: The rules' own dials: numbers that belong to no one monster, item or light. Read by js/world.js, js/traits.js, js/levelgen.js. Drawing numbers stay with drawing; the player's own settings stay in the browser.

notes.player: hit points to start; the bare blow (as a dagger's till there are weapons); healing, a hit point every so many turns, resting and not
notes.levels: experience each level needs, all told; hit points each new level gives
notes.ailments: bleeding from a hard blow (at damage or more, by a monster that bleeds, chance of the time), a hit point a turn for some turns, stopped by resting; poison, a hit point every so many turns for a while
notes.pack: how many things carried; the pack's letters; bare hands' blow; things lying about (one for every so many rooms); the chance a monster drops something
notes.chase: an aggressive pack gives up after calm turns not seeing the player, or at once further off than lose; the chance a chasing monster gets a shut door open
notes.whack: the player's chance to hit; sneak: a blow at a monster that hasn't noticed them always lands, so many times as hard
notes.sneakStep: a step with the lamp out takes so many turns
notes.aware: awareness (0 to 1) grows each turn a monster sees or hears the player and ebbs while it doesn't; at a third, suspicious; full, alarmed
notes.noise: each noise: how far it carries, how loud
notes.senses: how much a monster sees and hears by its state
notes.morale: when no more than half a pack is left, the rest flee for so many turns
notes.secret: the chance each turn of seeing a secret door near and two squares off, searching and not; how far
notes.murky: a murky potion that heals (as a strong one), or poisons (so many turns, so much harm at once)
notes.curse: lifting a curse: so many turns next to an altar
notes.itemTrait: how often a thing found has a trait; bad and good weighed by depth
notes.monsterBleed: a monster bleeding from a sharp blade: from a blow of at least at, a hit point a turn for so many turns
notes.monsterTrait: how often a pack has a trait; how often its leader has its own
notes.roomTrait: how many rooms a level has with a trait
notes.levelgen: the level generator's settings (see the notes in js/levelgen.js)
